mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the manual observation with the local status page was most worthwhile: it showed how to share useful information without pretending the disconnected sensor worked.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the finished status page found no available combinations, so it added little while I was trying to find the remaining goal requirement.

surprise.text: The power bank could not be used until the controller had been configured with its owner's management key; that prerequisite was not initially obvious.

arbitrary.text: Having to combine the controller with the already key-opened door to establish the two entry routes was not obvious to me, although the resulting test had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing how the modest local network is extended, particularly because this chapter kept its limitations and fallback mechanisms explicit.
